# Website dependencies

- Three.js 0.166.1, MIT; license preserved in THREE-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.166.1/build/three.module.min.js
- GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, copyright GreenSock / Webflow. Original proprietary headers are retained. Standard license: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/ . Sources: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js . These are used by this static marketing website, not an animation-authoring tool.
- Plus Jakarta Sans, Fraunces and JetBrains Mono: local Fontsource WOFF2 files, with their respective license files in fonts/.

All scripts and fonts needed by the cinematic page are served locally. No CDN connection is required at runtime.
